The request-parameter half of the request/response pair is undocumented-by-reference on the response page that most needs it.

cross_component_finding: Two separate near-misses found on this page beyond the three the round context flagged. (1) The 'Consistency' section's at_plus/not_bounded descriptions are near-verbatim identical to the already-promoted n1ql:scan-consistency's own descriptions of the same two literal token names ('Executes the query, requiring indexes first to be updated to the timestamp of the last update' vs. this page's own wording for at_plus is word-for-word identical; 'Executes the query immediately, without requiring any consistency for the query' likewise for not_bounded). This is NOT the same mechanism, however: n1ql:scan-consistency is a 4-member enum (not_bounded/at_plus/request_plus/statement_plus) governing N1QL's index-scan freshness via a `scan_consistency` request parameter, while this page's mechanism is FTS's own 2-member `ctl.consistency.level` setting governing per-partition-index freshness via vBucket sequence-number vectors - a structurally analogous but textually-borrowed-sounding, separately-implemented feature for a different service. Minted fts:search-consistency-level rather than reusing or merging with n1ql:scan-consistency, and recorded the resemblance here rather than silently. (2) The 'Scoring' section states 'Couchbase uses a slightly modified version of the standard tf-idf algorithm. This deviation is to normalize the score and is based on tf-idf algorithm' - a real implementation nuance (score normalization) that neither of round 22's promoted search:scoring-model / search:scoring-algorithm-enum records mention. This page also links onward to fts-scoring.md (round context's flagged near-miss-risk-2 page) via 'For more details on scores, follow the link [Scoring](fts-scoring.md)' - that page is out of this batch's assignment, so the risk-2 comparison itself is left for whichever batch reads fts-scoring.md; recorded here only as a seeAlso link and this one enrichment.
